san-francisco-bay-area-skyline-boulevard.story: Scenery first, traffic last, with checkpoints that make sense on a bike. Out of Kensington and back again: 302 km, roughly 5 h 29 in the saddle. On the way it passes Petaluma, Bolinas and South San Francisco. The climbs: El Granada, near Newark and Scenic stretch near Castro Valley. Long stretches are under trees.

scenicChapters.title: Abric del Ciervo → Barranco de las Colochas- Abrigo I
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 48 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-abrigo-de-rosser-rock-art-of-the-.story: From Millares it runs 307 km to Millares; allow about 5 h 18 of riding. The stops in between: Peñon de los machos, Abric del Ciervo, Barranco de las Colochas- Abrigo I and Rock Art of the Mediterranean Basin on the. The highest point is about 950 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

places-barranc-del-puig-abric-i-abric-de.story: A 171 km round trip from Benassal - roughly 2 h 57 in the saddle. On the way it passes Abric mas de la Roca, Galeria del Roure, Abric de la Tenalla and back through Galeria del Roure. The highest point is about 1,100 m. The line favours views over speed.
